<ins>Myrrh Pill (沒藥丸)</ins>
Myrrh (沒藥, oil removed), frankincense (乳香, oil removed), chuanxiong (川芎), Sichuan pepper (川椒, closed-mouth ones and the eyes removed), peony (芍藥), dang gui (當歸, each half liang), pyrite (自然銅, calcined and quenched seven times, two and a half qian)
Above, grind into fine powder; melt two liang of yellow wax (黃蠟), add the medicinal powder and stir evenly, make into pills the size of a pellet (彈子); take one pill per dose, dissolve it in one cup of wine, decoct to five-tenths and take hot. <ins>Scallion Ironing Method (蔥熨法)</ins> (the formula is found under injury of the fontanel bone, 囟骨傷)
<ins>Rehmannia Pill (地黃丸)</ins> (the formula is found under pain in the muscles, 肌肉作痛)
